Options:
  --host HOST                       Select the database server
  -h HOST                           Select the database server
  --port PORT                       Select the server port
  -p PORT                           Select the server port
  --username USER                   Select the database user
  -U USER                           Select the database user
  --dbname DBNAME                   Select the database or connection string
  -d DBNAME                         Select the database
  --command COMMAND                 Supply an SQL or backslash command as one shell argument
  -c COMMAND                        Supply one shell command argument
  --file FILE                       Read input commands from a file
  -f FILE                           Read input commands from a file
  --no-psqlrc                       Skip startup files
  -X                                Skip startup files
  --no-password                     Never prompt for a password
  --password                        Prompt for a password
  --set NAME_VALUE                  Set a psql variable
  -v NAME_VALUE                     Set a psql variable
  --tuples-only                     Omit headings and footers
  --csv                             Use CSV output
  --single-transaction              Wrap input in one transaction
